answer.answerText:
No. A filing representative cannot attest for the applicant or owner, and cannot submit the job filing. The applicant must complete the Applicant of Record’s attestation and electronic signature before submission; the owner must complete the Owner’s Attestation to authorize the applicant to submit and acknowledge review of the application. The applicant reviews, gives the final electronic signature, and officially submits the job filing to the Department. (LOC) is requested separately on each filing.

"},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"Full Demolition - The dismantling, razing, or removal of all of a building or structure, including all related incidental opera tions . "},{"spanIndex":20,"text":"The Full
"},{"spanIndex":21,"text":"Demolition Types are: New Work, Emergency Declaration, Immediate Emergency Declaration, Emergency Work Order, and Precept. "},{"spanIndex":22,"text":"A

"},{"spanIndex":24,"text":"conditions are met:
"},{"spanIndex":25,"text":"• Building is greater than 3 stories in height
"},{"spanIndex":26,"text":"• Building is greater than 5,000 square feet per floor
"},{"spanIndex":27,"text":"• Building is not detached
"},{"spanIndex":28,"text":"• Demolition Is using mechanical equipment
"},{"spanIndex":29,"text":"• Foundation is not being removed"}]},{"passageIndex":2,"sourceID":"dob-application-guide","claimID":"official-passage-5bdd162d6e75ae930ee42abc","contentHash":"9befc1cc76dd0efbfb76fed2960c262f1c4a61fc8dd786f9c30341251cc852b5","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"Page 19 of 38
"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"Does this application include a new roof or the replacing of an entire existing roof deck or roof assembly? "},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"(GC work type)
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"If yes is selected, Local Law 92/94 of 2019 Sustainable R oof Zone will populate in the Required Documents section.
"},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"Is this application filed in connection with a development, enlargement, or change in use, as defined in Zoning Resolution Se ction 12 - 10? "},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"(FO, ST,

"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"If yes is selected, enter a related New Building, Alteration CO or Alteration with enlargement job filing number. "},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"DOB NOW wil l check if there is an

"},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"(subsequent filings). "},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"It always preferred to create subsequent filings rather than adding job filing numbers to this field.
"},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"Additional Considerations, Limitations or Restrictions
"},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"Landmark . "},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"Approval from the Landmarks Preservation Commission (LPC) is required to ensure that work proposed under the application

"},{"spanIndex":27,"text":"1968, or prior to 1968. "},{"spanIndex":28,"text":"See the 2022 Construction Codes Updates to DOB NOW guide , pages 4 - 6, for code review selection options based
"},{"spanIndex":29,"text":"on job type, filing date and work type .

"},{"spanIndex":38,"text":"BIS property p rofile indicates t he LOFT designation , ‘Yes’ is auto - populated."}]},{"passageIndex":3,"sourceID":"dob-subsequent-faq","claimID":"official-passage-77183aa15dad687a6565894d","contentHash":"ce6d0104578e5fbf53f716249cd0047ba2c135a78bff42ede2ef273eddae44fe","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — When can I submit a subsequent job filing? — Subsequent filings can be initiated and submitted after the initial job filing is submitted (not in pre-filing status). "},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"Users no longer have to wait until the initial filing is approved. "},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"A subsequent filing can be submitted anytime until an LOC has been issued for the initial filing.
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — Do I have to request a Letter of Completion (LOC) for a subsequent job filing? — Yes, an LOC needs to be requested for each filing, initial and subsequent filings.
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — If an initial job application is filed as professional certification can the subsequent application be filed as a standard plan filing type? — Yes, initial and subsequent jobs can have different filing types.
"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — Can a subsequent filing have a different design applicant than the initial filing? — Yes, the applicant on an initial filing and a subsequent filing can be different. "},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"If the applicant is the same, one application can be submitted if the work types are eligible to be combine filed.
"},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":11,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — Do I have to pay the record management fee on a subsequent filing? — No, the $165 record management fee is now charged only once on the initial filing and is no longer a fee on subsequent filings.
"},{"spanIndex":12,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":13,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — Can I have an open PAA for the initial filing and a subsequent filing at the same time? — Yes.
"},{"spanIndex":14,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — How can I make a minor change to a legalization filing? — Post-Approval Amendments (PAA) are not allowed on filings that include legalization work. "},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"If a change needs to be made, a subsequent filing will be required or the job must be withdrawn and refiled. "},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"For Boiler Equipment filings the only option is to withdraw and refile the job. "},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"In addition, permits cannot be renewed if the job includes legalization work.
"},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":20,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — I have a subsequent filing in pre-filing status and some of the fields are grayed out? "},{"spanIndex":21,"text":"How do I complete these fields? — Fields from the subsequent filing are populated from the initial filing (I1). "},{"spanIndex":22,"text":"The fields will not update on the subsequent filing until the I1 is submitted. "},{"spanIndex":23,"text":"To prevent this issue, we recommend completing as much of the I1 as possible before creating the subsequent filing."}]},{"passageIndex":4,"sourceID":"dob-nb-altco-faq","claimID":"official-passage-6283ff3920bc66aa0bd34389","contentHash":"b5d4f1834964f64fb25bb7a5c31746d2131ccf70f9f7885b5003d54e07d9e92e","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > New Building and Alteration-CO — Are Structural (ST) and Foundation (FO) work types required for New Building (NB) filings? — Each NB should have FO and ST work types that may be combine filed with the General Construction (GC) in the initial application if the applicant is the same or filed as subsequent filings to the GC work type."}]},{"passageIndex":5,"sourceID":"dob-nb-altco-faq","claimID":"official-passage-42b3262068b7a32078d4c986","contentHash":"b5d4f1834964f64fb25bb7a5c31746d2131ccf70f9f7885b5003d54e07d9e92e","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > New Building and Alteration-CO — Do I need to request a Letter of Completion for the subsequent filing of an NB or Alteration-CO filing? — No, the status of the subsequent filings will remain Permit Entire. "},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"Only the status of the initial (I1) filing will change to CO issued. "},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"If a Temporary CO is issued, the status of the initial job will remain Permit Entire until the Final CO is issued."}]}]}}

"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"Stakeholders
"},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"All stakeholders require an eFiling account. "},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"Visit www.nyc.gov/efilin gtips for more information. "},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"All grayed - out fields will auto - populate with
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"information from the eFiling account.
"},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"Applicant and Owner: Enter the email address associated with the eFiling account of the Applicant and Owner . "},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"In most cases, the Applicant is a
"},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"Registered Architect or Professional Engineer. "},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"For the Applicant, also select the License Type and Business Name. "},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"For the owner, select the Owner
"},{"spanIndex":11,"text":"Type. "},{"spanIndex":12,"text":"If the Owner Type selected is Non - Profit Organization, NYC Agency, O ther Government Owned or NYCHA/HHC, then the fees will be removed
"},{"spanIndex":13,"text":"and an ACRIS report is required to verify the building is tax exempt.
"},{"spanIndex":14,"text":"Filing Representative and Delegated Associates : An email address can also be entered for Filing Representative Class I/ Preparer and Delegated
"},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"Associates (Filing Representative Class II or Other Licensee).
"},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"Filing Review Type, Work Type /Filing Includes
"},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"The Filing includes – select if the application is for New Work or Legalization . "},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"This option cannot be changed once the filing fees are paid.
"},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"If Legalization is selected and there is no OATH summons on the BIN for work without permit (WWP), then a $600 or $6000 fee, depending on the
"},{"spanIndex":20,"text":"building type, is added to the filing fees as a legalization fee. "},{"spanIndex":21,"text":"If legalization is selected and an OATH summons number for WWP is on the BIN,
"},{"spanIndex":22,"text":"select Yes to the question Are there any OATH/E CB summonses related to this work? "},{"spanIndex":23,"text":"and enter the DOB violation or OATH/ECB Summons
"},{"spanIndex":24,"text":"number(s). "},{"spanIndex":25,"text":"When a WWP violation is entered, there is no legalization fee and only a civil penalty for work without permit cal culated as an L2 fee.
"},{"spanIndex":26,"text":"An L2 is a request for ove rride, reduction or waiver of civil penalties for work without a permit violations. "},{"spanIndex":27,"text":"When the L2 request is created, the civil
"},{"spanIndex":28,"text":"penalty fee has to be paid before the permit is issued. "},{"spanIndex":29,"text":"Once legalization is selected on a filing, it results in a no work pe rmit and Post Approval
"},{"spanIndex":30,"text":"Amendments are not allowed. "},{"spanIndex":31,"text":"See 1 RCNY 102 - 04 (b) (7 ) for more information about legalization and civil penalties.
"},{"spanIndex":32,"text":"The work is being done to legalize work without a permit listed as a violating condition in a Request for Corrective Action ( RCA) issued by DOB?
"},{"spanIndex":33,"text":"– if Yes is selected, provide the complaint number of the RCA. "},{"spanIndex":34,"text":"See 1 RCNY 102 - 06 and the September 2021 Service Notice for information about the
"},{"spanIndex":35,"text":"Homeowner Relief Program.
"},{"spanIndex":36,"text":"Filing Review T ype - auto - populated based on the selection made when creating the application and cannot be changed.
"},{"spanIndex":37,"text":"The below selections are auto - populated based on the selection made when creating the application but can be changed in this section:
"},{"spanIndex":38,"text":"Is this Application for a Small Business?
"},{"spanIndex":39,"text":"Is this Application for an approved project under the M ajor Project Developments Program (MPP) ?"}]},{"passageIndex":1,"sourceID":"dob-application-guide","claimID":"official-passage-14224abff07118e8caab44b5","contentHash":"9befc1cc76dd0efbfb76fed2960c262f1c4a61fc8dd786f9c30341251cc852b5","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"Page 38 of 38
"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"STATEMENTS & SIGNATURES
"},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"Applicant o f Record ’s Attestation
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"The applicant completes the section to provide an electronic signature before the application can be submitted. "},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"The applicant also uploads a
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"Design Professional/Licensee Seal and Signature Form (DPL - 1) as a Required Document. "},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"The date on the form cannot be more than one year from
"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"the date of submission.
"},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"Owner’s Attestation
"},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"All job filings in DOB NOW require confirmation from the Owner authorizing the applicant to submit the filing and acknowledging that the
"},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"information in the application has been reviewed. "},{"spanIndex":11,"text":"An Owner provides confirmation by completing the Owner’s Attestation sectio n of the
"},{"spanIndex":12,"text":"Statements & Signatures tab .
"},{"spanIndex":13,"text":"Occupied Dwelling Units (Questions 1 - 4)
"},{"spanIndex":14,"text":"If the owner selects Yes to Question 1, occupied dwelling units during construction , a Tenant Protection Plan (TPP) is required. "},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"A TPP is required if
"},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"residential units will be occupied any time before the permit is signed off by DOB. "},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"Questions 3 - 4 determine compliance requirement s with tenant
"},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"protection laws based on whether residential units are occupied at the time of application.
"},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"Rent Controlled or Rent Stabilized Housing (Questions 5 - 6)
"},{"spanIndex":20,"text":"This information is checked with data provided by NYS Homes and Community Renewal (DHCR) if at least one rent - regulated unit is in the building.
"},{"spanIndex":21,"text":"If there is at least one rent - regulated unit in the building and the owner checks No to Question 5, a document is required confirming the building
"},{"spanIndex":22,"text":"contains 0 rent controlled/stabilized units and expla ining why the DHCR records are inaccurate. "},{"spanIndex":23,"text":"Otherwise, owners must check Yes to Question 5.
"},{"spanIndex":24,"text":"Loft Board Notification (Question 7)
"},{"spanIndex":25,"text":"Owners proposing work to convert their loft buildings into legal residences are required to notify the NYC Loft Board at (212 ) 393 - 2603 and ask for
"},{"spanIndex":26,"text":"the Public Information Officer.
"},{"spanIndex":27,"text":"Interior Work (Questions 8 - 10)
"},{"spanIndex":28,"text":"If the proposed work requires a TPP and the owner checks Yes to Questions 8, 9, or 10, a Tenant Protection Plan Compliance special inspection will
"},{"spanIndex":29,"text":"not be required.
"},{"spanIndex":30,"text":"Owner Arrears (Questions 11 - 12)
"},{"spanIndex":31,"text":"This section appears on New Building, Alteration - CO, and Full Demolition filings to comply with Local Law 160 of 2017 . "},{"spanIndex":32,"text":"If the owner answers Yes to
"},{"spanIndex":33,"text":"either question, a list of exceptions will appear as Question 13. "},{"spanIndex":34,"text":"If an exception is not selected, a permit cannot be obtaine d."}]},{"passageIndex":2,"sourceID":"dob-stakeholder-faq","claimID":"official-passage-3cbff49879cfb553effe4168","contentHash":"560ef552813acde4b43ba46ad68edd6a8e165b9d34e6bfa27aa7f243bccc8f82","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Roles & Responsibilities: Owner — As an owner, what information can I enter and access in DOB NOW: Build ? — Owners can review the filing, complete the Owner’s Attestation section on the Statements and Signatures tab and make payments on their jobs. "},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"They can also view all documents that are part of their job."}]},{"passageIndex":3,"sourceID":"dob-stakeholder-faq","claimID":"official-passage-7bf0922128b4c87c1cd9cc0e","contentHash":"560ef552813acde4b43ba46ad68edd6a8e165b9d34e6bfa27aa7f243bccc8f82","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Roles & Responsibilities: Professionals — As a Filing Representative, what information can I enter and access in DOB NOW: Build ? — Filing Representatives can enter and view all filing information (PW1, Scope of Work, PW3, Technical Reports and PW2) that are part of the filing. "},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"They can make payments on jobs that they are associated with. "},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"They cannot upload plans or submit filings/permits."}]},{"passageIndex":4,"sourceID":"dob-stakeholder-faq","claimID":"official-passage-44ed314c52e3eddef0be989e","contentHash":"560ef552813acde4b43ba46ad68edd6a8e165b9d34e6bfa27aa7f243bccc8f82","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Roles & Responsibilities: Professionals — Can a filing representative submit a work permit? — No, a filing representative can do the data entry of the work permit application but only the applicant of the permit (contractor) can submit it."}]},{"passageIndex":5,"sourceID":"dob-build-release-notes","claimID":"official-passage-53a7b00a20a15149e08db0e5","contentHash":"03c2b6c9eac3f540be3911f8813b3e1a3591c25f78c7bc721d19d3ce3678b9e0","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"March 2026 – Green Roof Tax Abatement in DOB NOW: Build (Continued)
"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"The New Tax Abatement tab includes:
"},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"• Maintenance Plan Author Information section to be
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"completed by a Registered Architect, Professional
"},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"Engineer, NYS Licensed and Registered Landscape
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"Architect, or a Horticulturist with a degree or
"},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"certificate from an accredited training institute.
"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"• Owner’s Attestation: Owners will need to log in to
"},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"DOB NOW to attest to the Tax Abatement information
"},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"in addition to completing the attestation on the
"},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"Statements & Signatures tab.
"},{"spanIndex":11,"text":"Select the Save Tax Abatement button at the top or
"},{"spanIndex":12,"text":"bottom of the screen after completion of each of these
"},{"spanIndex":13,"text":"sections. "},{"spanIndex":14,"text":"The Tax abatement tab can be edited at any
"},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"point up until LOC Request."}]},{"passageIndex":6,"sourceID":"dob-build-release-notes","claimID":"official-passage-2e6a1d190b996cb029e2e04a","contentHash":"03c2b6c9eac3f540be3911f8813b3e1a3591c25f78c7bc721d19d3ce3678b9e0","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"February 2026 - Condo/Co - Op Board added as a Stakeholder in PW1
"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"When Condo Unit Owner or Co - Op Tenant - Shareholder is selected as the Owner Type on a DOB NOW job filing, the Condo/Co - Op
"},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"Board will be added as a required Stakeholder.
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"▪ The Board’s representative must log in to DOB NOW using an NYC.ID account and attest that the Board has authorized the
"},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"applicant to file the application.
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"▪ Both the owner and the Board representative are required complete their attestations on the Statements & Signatures tab before
"},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"the filing can proceed."}]},{"passageIndex":7,"sourceID":"dob-build-release-notes","claimID":"official-passage-fb868e89e2df8a94e8ce4331","contentHash":"03c2b6c9eac3f540be3911f8813b3e1a3591c25f78c7bc721d19d3ce3678b9e0","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"November 2024 – Deleting Paid Filings
"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"November 8, 2024
"},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"A stakeholder on a filing (Applicant, Owner, Filing Representative, Delegated Associate, Permit Applicant) can delete
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"the following type of filings, even if they are paid for, if they are in Pre - Filing or Objections/QA Failed status:
"},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"• After Hours Variance Permits (AHV)
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"• Elevator Filings
"},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"• OP 49 Boiler Removal Notifications
"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"• Post Approval Amendments
"},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"• Supersede Requests
"},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"• Withdrawal Requests
"},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"• Work Permit (PW2) Renewals"}]},{"passageIndex":8,"sourceID":"dob-filing-submission-steps","claimID":"official-passage-4ec8217cc82335520d8bd371","contentHash":"ada9cee3950fd42b1dc9d78b447937b49af93ce65fb15593a5457c7a3f46eaa9","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"Filing through DOB NOW: Build > STEP 4: Obtain Attestation — • Applicant (PE/RA), property owners and other stakeholders must electronically sign the job filing."}]},{"passageIndex":9,"sourceID":"dob-filing-submission-steps","claimID":"official-passage-00c8d295a909c5b6a06f2419","contentHash":"ada9cee3950fd42b1dc9d78b447937b49af93ce65fb15593a5457c7a3f46eaa9","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"Filing through DOB NOW: Build > STEP 6: Preview Submission — • Applicant must review the filing and provide a final electronic signature."}]},{"passageIndex":10,"sourceID":"dob-filing-submission-steps","claimID":"official-passage-269a24e126eb0a4c11c73ca6","contentHash":"ada9cee3950fd42b1dc9d78b447937b49af93ce65fb15593a5457c7a3f46eaa9","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"Filing through DOB NOW: Build > STEP 7: Submit Job Filing — • Applicant officially submits the job filing to the Department electronically."}]}]}}
